page.layout: One printed title page, single column, centred; an engraved oval emblem with motto in the lower middle; imprint below the emblem. No running head, no page number, no margin text. A library pencil mark at the top is not printed text and is left out.

l.i: Multæ sunt hominum scientiæ : sed nulla melior illâ,
quâ homo seipsum cognoscit. Bern. de Interi. dom.

page.notes: Engraved emblem within an oval frame, with the words IN NOCTE and CONSILIVM on either side, showing an owl perched above two intertwined serpents with flowers and foliage; no text is printed on the emblem beyond these two words. The pencil shelf mark "Bb 1212" at the top is not transcribed. The motto line is set in italic; "Bern." and "dom." are printed with the points shown. The small mark below the motto is a printer's ornament, not text.
